records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three and nine months ended September 30, 2024, we generated $266.7 million and $786.6 million in total revenue, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended September 30, 2024 was: cloud subscriptions 33%; software license 1%; maintenance 13%; services 51%; and hardware 2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the nine months ended September 30, 2024 was: cloud subscriptions 31%; software license 1%; maintenance 13%; services 52%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $34.3 million and $104.7 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2024, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $62.3 million and $190.3 million, respectively.
